method: literal protocol with Delta = 1 in the moving frame W_r = R_r D_r; one-period propagator U_F in 40-digit arithmetic (Taylor integrator), slow O(1/T) terms in the interaction picture of U_F (authoring/provenance/sim3.py; sim.py steps every period and agrees at N = 1e3, 1e4)
note: Corrections are O(eps_N) = O(N^-1/8) (micromotion dressing of the slow connection), so convergence in N is very slow; the deviation is linear in eps at small eps and extrapolates to the exact value.
